channel.title: WebToolNest Blog
channel.description: Practical how-to guides from WebToolNest — PDFs and photos, keyboards and mice, internet speed, GPA, speeches, Instagram, Discord and more — each with a free tool to do the job.

item.title: How to Calculate Your GPA (Step by Step) and Convert It to a Percentage
item.description: Learn the GPA formula with a worked example, how cumulative GPA works across semesters, and how to convert a 4.0 or 10-point GPA to a percentage.

item.title: How to Convert HEIC to JPG on Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android
item.description: iPhone photos saved as HEIC won't open everywhere. Convert HEIC to JPG for free on any device — one photo or hundreds at once — and stop your iPhone saving HEIC in future.

item.title: How to Make a Booklet From a PDF (Print, Fold and Staple)
item.description: Turn any PDF into a booklet you can print double-sided, fold and staple. Free step-by-step guide with the right printer settings, paper sizes and tips for thick booklets.

item.title: How to Test a Laptop Keyboard (and Fix Keys That Stop Working)
item.description: Test every key on your laptop keyboard online in a minute, find dead, sticky or double-pressing keys, and try the fixes that work on Windows laptops and MacBooks.

item.title: Mouse Double Clicking on a Single Click? How to Test and Fix It
item.description: If your mouse double clicks when you click once, test it in your browser to confirm the fault, then try these fixes — from Windows settings to cleaning and replacing the switch.

item.title: What Is a Good Internet Speed? Mbps Explained for Streaming, Gaming and Work
item.description: A good internet speed for most homes is 100 Mbps download and 10–20 Mbps upload. See how much speed streaming, gaming, video calls and working from home really need.

item.title: Discord Timestamps: How to Show a Time in Everyone's Time Zone
item.description: Discord timestamps like <t:1767225600:F> show every member an event time in their own time zone. All 7 formats with examples, and how to make one in seconds.

item.title: How Many Words Is a 5-Minute Speech? (Chart for 1 to 60 Minutes)
item.description: A 5-minute speech is about 650 words at an average pace of 130 words per minute. See a chart for 1–60 minute speeches, common speech lengths and how to time yours.

item.title: How to Import Contacts From Excel to iPhone, Android or Gmail
item.description: Turn an Excel or CSV list of names and phone numbers into phone contacts: convert it to a VCF file, then import it on iPhone, Android or Google Contacts.

item.title: How to See Who Unfollowed You on Instagram (Free, No App)
item.description: See who doesn't follow you back on Instagram using Instagram's own data download — no password and no risky follower apps. Step-by-step for iPhone, Android and computer.

item.title: Stick Drift: How to Test It and Fix It (PS5, Xbox, Switch and PC)
item.description: Is your controller drifting? Test both sticks in your browser in 5 seconds, learn what causes stick drift, and try the fixes that work — from calibration and deadzones to cleaning and repair.

item.title: What Is a Good Typing Speed? Average WPM, Job Requirements and How to Improve
item.description: A good typing speed is about 50–70 words per minute with 95%+ accuracy. See the average WPM, what speed different jobs ask for, and practical ways to type faster.
